confidences.reason: At step 12, the WebSurfer remained at the top of the USGS NAS species profile page, stated that the brief header/identification snippet was all the visible text, and did not scroll or navigate to the sections (e.g., Collection Info or the Nonindigenous Occurrences/Table 1) that typically contain earliest observation years by state. The orchestrator had explicitly requested exploring 'Collection Info and other sections,' but the agent did not do so. The log and OCR confirm no further navigation or scrolling occurred.

Up to step 11, the flow correctly identified and opened the relevant USGS NAS species profile page where the needed occurrence data likely resides. At step 12, WebSurfer failed to navigate to or reveal the 'Collection Info' (or equivalent occurrence table) where the earliest year by state would be shown, instead remaining on the identification section. This was the first point where the agent failed to access the necessary information on the already-correct page, contributing to the incorrect final answer.
After Step 12, the session hit an error and proceeded to a final (incorrect) answer of 1976 without revisiting the USGS page or extracting the year. No subsequent steps corrected the omission.
Step 12 exists in the log and its agent is 'WebSurfer'.
